g.text: "A backup is not trustworthy merely because it exists. Atlas verifies that it can actually be restored."
Nginx Reverse Proxy · Strict Container Isolation
Backlog Discovery: Drains unsynced historical backups
Local backups are NEVER pruned unless verified offsite.
Cloud receipt confirmed → Retention allowed to prune old copy
STRICT RETENTION BLOCK: Backup preserved locally.
Queued in backlog for next successful sync run.
Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3 Object Storage
Public X25519 Recipient Key on Host (age -r)
Zero Private Keys on VPS · Cold Storage Identity
rclone copyto / aws s3 cp · TLS Encrypted
Explicit Remote LSF / LS Listing Check
rclone lsf / aws s3 ls | grep <object>
Only writes .synced marker after confirmed presence
ZONE 5: ISOLATED DISASTER RECOVERY SANDBOX (RESTORE DRILL ENGINE)
Zero state modification on live DB
Backup is proven restorable before disaster
